svg.title: Resonate deployment architecture
svg.desc: Deployment view of Resonate on Google Cloud: clients reach an optional global HTTPS edge with managed TLS, Cloud Armor, a host-based URL map and serverless NEGs in front of Cloud Run frontend and backend services; the backend reaches Cloud SQL, Redis, Cloud Storage, Secret Manager and Pub/Sub over a private VPC, starts Demucs jobs, calls the GPU Stable Audio service, runs scheduled jobs, and feeds a streaming (Dataflow) or batch (BigQuery subscription) analytics pipeline into BigQuery and Dataform marts. Vertex AI, ERC-4337 smart accounts, Resonate contracts and x402 USDC settlement sit outside the cloud boundary. Delivery runs from exact-SHA signed images in the app repository to digest-verified Terraform reconciliation in resonate-iac.
